customManagers.description: CLI tools pinned for CI: a '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' comment directly above each NAME_VERSION=value line
Vendored Gateway API CRD bundle: the version in the release URL in the comment above the vendored file

packageRules.description: The Applications' own git sources follow main on purpose; only chart versions are dependencies
Envoy Gateway and its CRD chart are two sources of one Application and must stay on the same version
Renovate can only bump the version in the comment next to the vendored bundle. CI fails until the bundle itself is re-vendored, so this never merges on its own
prBodyNotes:
This PR only changes the version in the comment. Before merging: check that the pinned Envoy Gateway release supports this Gateway API version (https://gateway.envoyproxy.io/news/releases/matrix/), then re-vendor the bundle on this branch (CI fails until you do):

`curl -fsSL https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api/releases/download/{{{newVersion}}}/standard-install.yaml -o infrastructure/base/gateway-api/standard-install.yaml`
